# Quantum Syndrome Memory

This repository contains the scientific account of a fixed iid pure-record memory theorem with sublinear predetermined homomorphism syndrome advice.

Read science/MODEL_AND_FRONTIER.md, science/SYNDROME_RIGIDITY.md, and science/PHASE_CHANNEL.md before summarizing claims. The main contribution is the advice-stability theorem; the no-advice helper frontier, coherence tools, and binary entropy lemma are prior inputs. State the fixed-source, pure-record, homomorphism, timing, and hard-memory assumptions. Do not generalize the result to arbitrary nonlinear/adaptive advice, noncommuting errors, QKD security, or a fault-tolerance threshold. science/INTERPRETATION.md and references/RELATED_WORK.md record the limits and attribution.

The deterministic script in verification/ tests finite-dimensional identities and examples, not the asymptotic proof. README.md is the reader entry point. Do not infer a manuscript submission or a release from repository readiness.

For a reader-independent learning route, use learning/MILESTONES.md (exactly 30 project-defined background and narrative milestones), with learning/WATROUS_BRIDGE.md for the sole educational anchor, Watrous (2018). The bridge maps relevant chapters, notation, assumptions and project-specific missing steps; do not attribute the new theorem to the textbook. Keep personalized coaching, assessment and learner progress outside this repository. For specialist questions, follow science/README.md to the authoritative topic pages, references/RELATED_WORK.md for provenance, and verification/README.md for finite checks.
